Goal: inspect the repo and produce a short Phase 1 implementation plan for a Typora-inspired reskin, per the design brief below. Read-only.

Context: repo /Users/sachinkoli/github/noteapp, branch claude/bref-swap (verify with `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`, do NOT switch branches, do NOT commit). The tree is the Bref single-crate codebase (package `bref`, GPUI 0.2.2, src/{main,actions,lang,logic,platform,ui,views,shell,mcp}/). Map: /Users/sachinkoli/github/bref/ARCHITECTURE.md is the code map (same code). The running reference binary is /Users/sachinkoli/github/noteapp/target/debug/bref.

Design brief (reskin, do NOT replace working infrastructure, preserve functionality):
- Product: minimal Typora-inspired document-first Markdown editor; content first, chrome quiet; unified edit+preview; keyboard-first; local-first.
- Layout: three regions — left file explorer (nav/search/highlight/collapsible/settings entry), center document canvas (centered, max-width ~800px, live preview, no permanent toolbar), right outline (heading hierarchy, click-to-navigate, stats). All panels independently toggleable; small screens prioritize document.
- Typography: Inter (UI/body/headings) + JetBrains Mono (code); body 16px/1.7, H1 30/H2 23/H3 19, UI 13-14, code 14, metadata 12; bundle OFL fonts locally with licences.
- Visuals: neutral surfaces, subtle separators, restrained accents, light+dark+sepia themes, centralized design tokens. Avoid IDE clutter, gradients, big buttons, permanent toolbars.
- Interactions: shortcuts, focus/typewriter modes, doc search, outline nav, word count, progress, auto-save, undo/redo, zoom.
- Phases: 1 Foundation (shell/layout/tokens/typography/themes/explorer), 2 Editor, 3 Document experience, 4 Productivity, 5 Polish.

Constraints: read-only. No builds/tests (already verified). No edits, no commits, no pushes. Do not touch /Users/sachinkoli/github/bref.

Done when: report (1) framework/renderer/parser/state-management as found (files:line), (2) existing components reusable for the 3-region layout + theming (theme.rs, nav, shell render), (3) how docs load/edit/save today, (4) platform constraints (macOS bundle, Linux CSD), (5) short Phase 1 plan proposing BOTH options: (a) document-canvas-first, (b) full-3-region-shell-first, with files to touch and risks each. Under 30 lines. Open questions welcome.
